reason: The price isn't the issue for a salon my size, but I've never heard of these people and no owner or distributor I know uses it. I won't put 15 staff and all my billing on an unknown app just because it has my logo on it.
objection: Many of my customers won't give their mobile number, especially bridal clients and older ladies, so the whole billing, WhatsApp reminder and wallet system falls apart. And if this small company shuts down in a year, my customer data and prepaid wallet balances go with it.
would_change_my_mind: If two or three established salon owners I know in Bhubaneswar were already running it happily for a few months and told me so themselves.
